entries.clue: Hind leg and rump of a deer, the big venison roasting joint
Chubby big-eyed celluloid figure from a Rose O'Neill cartoon, won at fairs
Slogan a party rallies behind, or the sentry's challenge of old
Rendered pig fat, white and solid, once the standard roasting medium
Set beef fat kept in a pot and once spread thickly on bread
Bound volume pairing each phrase with its secret group
Hidden message spelled by the first letter of each line
Metal disc fed into an amusement machine in place of a coin
Thin unthickened meat juices poured as a sauce, under a French name
Sea snail sold by the pot with vinegar along the pleasure beach
The letter E in the radio alphabet, or a canyon's reply
Prime beef joint from the back, said to be knighted by a king
Toothed wheel turning deep in the machinery that drives a ride
Shared secret word that sets up the scrambling
